text:
ana-marketing: Quick ask for the launch deck - can runtime run a focused microprobe we can cite? Need small, reproducible artifacts only.

ana-marketing: Requirements: 3k requests, 3 seeds, seq-length mix 128/512/1024 (70/25/5), steady 15 qps to mimic demo; report p50/p90/p95/p99 and token-cost delta q4_0 vs fp16. CSV of raw latencies + single heatmap. Deadline: Fri noon PT.

sam-runtime: Sounds ok. Which model binary? And which infra pool?

ana-marketing: Use open-candidate-1.1. Run on bench-pool-small. Warmup: 50 requests per worker.

sam-runtime: Will include seed in traces and add a mismatch check for top-1 token diffs; will surface any bins >0.5%. Expect ~45-75m run.

vikas-eng: Please include perf.conf excerpt with batching and warmup settings for the blog footnote. Also log prefix_cache_hits.

sam-runtime: Perf snippet I'll attach and I will log prefix_cache_hits, kernel_select, and fallback_to_fp16 counters.

ci-bot: job scheduled: microprobe-1820005000 on bench-pool-small at 1820006000 UTC (owner: sam-runtime).

sam-runtime: Kickoff now. Interim: seed=7 shows p95 at 380ms for 512, q4_0 token-cost +7.2%, top-1 mismatch overall 0.12%. Uploading artifacts to /shared/marketing/launch_checks/microprobe-1820005000/.

jo-analytics: I'll pull CSV and prep percentiles + one slide PNG. If mismatch >0.5% anywhere, call it out.

ana-marketing: Thanks all 389; if infra issues ping here. Will draft slide copy after artifacts.
